# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 3: Nova Elysia Three Religious Paths, Western Pantheon & Pyrophoroi/Copper-Clad Military (oe_eln_, 0 slots). Generated by gen_elysia_faith_military.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Convoke the Three Faiths Council of Nova Elysia (manual trigger if player acts before automatic oe_eln.3)
oe_eln_dec_choose_faith_path = {
	decision_category = religious_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		is_ai = no
		oe_eln_is_elysia_host = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_faith_path }
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev3_fired }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_eln_human_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		stability >= -25
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:clergy_estate background = estate_type:crown_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_eln_dec_choose_faith_path.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_eln_dec_choose_faith_path_tt
			set_variable = oe_eln_ev3_fired
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.3
		}
	}
}

# 2. Western Pantheon of Hesperia Seat-Swapper (strictly maintains <= 6 active gods across ADM/DIP/MIL)
oe_eln_dec_western_pantheon = {
	decision_category = religious_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_ai = no
		exists = religion
		religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
		OR = {
			oe_eln_has_any_western_god_unlocked = yes
			oe_eln_has_any_western_god_seated = yes
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_eln_human_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		exists = religion
		religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:clergy_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_eln_dec_western_pantheon.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_eln_dec_western_pantheon_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
				oe_eln_purge_unseated_gods = yes
				oe_eln_enforce_six_god_cap = yes
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln_pantheon.1
		}
	}
}

# 3. Link Atlantic Sanctuaries to the Collegium Pontificum (oe_romp_pontificate IO)
oe_eln_dec_join_atlantic_pontificate = {
	decision_category = religious_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_ai = no
		oe_eln_is_elysia_host = yes
		exists = religion
		religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
		NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = oe_romp_pontificate } }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_eln_human_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		exists = religion
		religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
		stability >= -20
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:clergy_estate background = estate_type:crown_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_eln_dec_join_atlantic_pontificate.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_eln_dec_join_atlantic_pontificate_tt
			oe_eln_join_or_create_pontificate = yes
			add_religious_influence_if_valid = { VALUE = 10 }
		}
	}
}

# 4. Joint Chalybopolis Pyrophoroi & Chesapeake Copper-Clad Fleet Trials (10-year cooldown)
oe_eln_dec_pyrophoroi_drills = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_ai = no
		oe_eln_is_elysia_host = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = oe_eln_pyrophoroi_ready
			has_variable = oe_eln_copper_galleon_ready
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_eln_human_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 120
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_eln_drills_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_drills_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:nobles } }
	option = {
		name = oe_eln_dec_pyrophoroi_drills.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_eln_dec_pyrophoroi_drills_tt
			add_gold = -120
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_drills_cd value = 1 years = 10 }
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_eln_pyrophoroi_fleet_readiness_mod
				years = 8
				mode = replace
			}
			add_army_tradition = army_tradition_mild_bonus
			add_navy_tradition = navy_tradition_mild_bonus
		}
	}
}
